system.description:
You manifest a construct of water release chakra in the shape of a large mallet, of your design and description that you use to make a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against a target creature within range. On a hit, you deal 4d6 cold damage and the target creature must make a Constitution Saving throw, being Bruised on a failed save.

If the target has ranks of an Elemental condition, they suffer a -2 penalty to their saving throw and this jutsu’s damage die increases by 1 step.

If a target of this jutsu is Grappled, this jutsu’s damage die increases by 1 step.

If used near a sufficient source of water, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or you can choose to increase the damage die of this jutsu by 1 step.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. When you cast this jutsu at B-Rank the number of attacks you make increases by +1. When you cast this Jutsu at S-Rank the number of attacks you make increases by +2.
